chapter: New Orleans clubs and Sharky's band
title: Tony Costa and Tony Almerico
summary: Praise for clarinetist Tony Costa, who played with Tony Almerico.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals

blocks.x: Which Tony was that that you worked at in the speakeasies? Tony Fusheret.
Yeah, that Tony. That's so easy to get confused when you, there's so many Tonys around to watch. Oh, yeah.

The finest clarinet player though I ever played with in my life was Tony Costa. Really? Yes. He's playing with Rene. Rene Lua? Yes. Tony Costa played the smoothest clarinet and still does. Most beautiful tone that you ever want to listen to. And his brother, Mike, also.
Which band were you with Tony in?
Tony Almerica. I mean, Tony Costa. Tony Costa with Tony Almerica. I got a recording. Oh, yeah. Yeah. I got recordings on all of that.
